title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Course Selection
Courses
are selected in accordance with the prescribed requirements of a
program
.
All students are responsible for the completeness and accuracy of their own registration
. Students should ensure that as they proceed they take the necessary prerequisites for
individual courses and the necessary courses for program progression.
The university reserves the right not to offer elective courses for which there is insufficient registration. Not all courses listed in this calendar are offered each year.
